pages.title: About Kidlo
pages.content:
Kidlo is a Pakistan-based online toy store for babies, toddlers, and growing kids. Parents shop by age, interest, and budget, then pay by cash on delivery, card, or mobile wallet.

We started in 2019 with a simple idea: safe toys should be easy to find, honestly priced, and delivered to the door. The catalogue mixes imported play sets with everyday favourites — RC cars, dolls, STEM kits, outdoor games, and baby toys.

How the shop works

  • Browse by category, age, or search.
  • Add to cart and check out with COD, card, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash.
  • Orders over PKR 2,000 ship free. Most parcels arrive in 2–5 days.
  • Unopened items can be returned within 30 days.

The storefront you see — hero, deals, categories, reviews, and pages — is edited from the Kidlo admin, so campaigns can change without a new release.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.content:
Kidlo began as a small Lahore storeroom and a WhatsApp catalogue. Parents kept asking for the same three things: an age label they could trust, a price in rupees without surprise fees, and a rider who actually called before arriving.

By 2022 the catalogue had grown past a thousand toys and delivery covered the major cities. The website now carries that same promise: show the real price, the real age range, and the stock we can ship.

What we still care about

  • Age guidance on every product.
  • Flash deals that end when the timer ends.
  • A person on WhatsApp when a gift has to arrive before a birthday.

pages.title: Careers
pages.content:
We hire buyers, warehouse leads, riders' coordinators, and customer guides in Lahore. Send a note with the role you want and a phone number. We read every inquiry from this page.

Open interests

  • Catalogue buyer — toys and baby
  • Customer support — Urdu and English
  • Warehouse associate — Gulberg dispatch

Use the form and choose Careers. There is no public application portal yet.

pages.title: Press Kit
pages.content:
Kidlo Toys Pvt. Ltd. is a direct-to-parent toy retailer based in Lahore, selling online across Pakistan since 2019.

  • Brand: Kidlo Toys
  • Site: this storefront
  • Focus: kids and baby toys, STEM, outdoor, gifts
  • Office: 14-B, Gulberg III, Lahore
  • Press email: hello@kidlotoys.pk

Please credit the brand as Kidlo when you mention the store.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
We collect the details needed to deliver an order: name, phone, address, city, and payment choice. Account passwords are stored as a salted hash. We do not sell customer lists.

Order data stays in the shop database (MySQL when it is available, and a JSON copy that keeps the site online if MySQL is down). Newsletter emails are stored only to send deals you asked for.

To review or delete an account, write to hello@kidlotoys.pk from the same email you used at checkout.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.content:
Prices are in Pakistani rupees and include the discount shown on the product. A promo code applies once per order and only when the minimum spend is met. Cash on delivery can be refused if the phone number does not answer after two attempts.

Toys are sold for the age marked on the page. Kidlo is not a marketplace of private sellers; stock is purchased and shipped by us. Risk of loss passes when the courier marks the parcel delivered.

pages.title: Wholesale
pages.content:
Schools, birthday planners, and retailers can request a trade list. Tell us the city, the age group, and roughly how many pieces you need. We reply within one working day with availability and a bill.

Wholesale pricing starts at 12 mixed pieces of the same SKU. Branded gift wrap is optional.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds
pages.content:
You have 30 days from delivery to return an unused toy in its original pack. Defective items are collected at our cost. Change-of-mind returns are picked up in major cities; the customer pays the rider fee elsewhere.

Refunds

  • COD orders are refunded by bank transfer or JazzCash.
  • Card payments go back to the same card in 5–7 working days after we receive the parcel.
  • Opened hygiene-sensitive baby items cannot be resold and are replaced only if faulty.

pages.title: FAQs
pages.content:
Do you deliver outside Lahore and Karachi?

Yes. Nationwide delivery is 2–5 days. Remote areas can take a day longer, and the courier calls before arrival.

Is cash on delivery available?

Yes, across Pakistan. Please keep the exact amount ready if you can. Card, EasyPaisa, and JazzCash are also offered at checkout.

How do I track an order?

Open Track My Order and enter the order number (for example KD1001) plus the phone used at checkout.

Are the toys safe for babies?

Check the age label on each product. Baby items are chosen for soft materials and no small detachable parts. Still supervise play.

Can I send a gift?

Orders over PKR 3,000 include free gift wrap and a short message. Add the message in the order notes.

pages.title: Shipping Info
pages.content:
Orders placed before 2 PM from Lahore or Karachi are dispatched the same day, Saturday included. Everyone else ships on the next working morning.

  • Free delivery on orders of PKR 2,000 or more.
  • A flat PKR 199 fee under that amount.
  • You receive the order number as soon as checkout completes.

If a toy is out of stock after you pay online, we refund that line before the parcel leaves.

pages.title: Size & Age Guide
pages.content:
Age bands on Kidlo match how children actually play, not only the factory label.

  • 0–2: sensory mats, teethers, push walkers. Nothing with small parts.
  • 3–5: big blocks, pretend play, first puzzles.
  • 6–8: RC cars, art sets, simple board games.
  • 9–11: STEM kits, strategy games, larger builds.
  • 12–14: coding robots, drones with an adult, hobby kits.
  • 15+: advanced kits. Drones and planes still need open space and supervision.

When a gift is between two ages, choose the interest first and the age second. Our WhatsApp team will sanity-check a cart.

pages.title: Gift Cards
pages.content:
Kidlo gift cards are issued by email as a code you can apply at checkout, same as a coupon. Ask for one through the contact form with the amount (PKR 1,000, 2,000, or 5,000) and the recipient phone.

Cards do not expire for 12 months and cannot be exchanged for cash.

pages.title: Bulk Orders
pages.content:
Planning a school stall, mehndi favours, or a society sports day? Send the date, city, and a rough list. We pack mixed boxes of outdoor toys, art kits, or baby gifts.

Lead time is usually 4 working days inside Punjab and 6 days for other provinces.

pages.title: Contact Us
pages.content:
Call or WhatsApp +92 300 1234567, email hello@kidlotoys.pk, or use the form. The Gulberg office is open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 9pm PKT.

For an order already placed, tracking with your order number is faster than a new message.

blog_posts.title: Best STEM Toys for 8–12 Year Olds in 2025
blog_posts.excerpt: Discover our expert picks for science and coding toys that make learning irresistibly fun for school-age children.
blog_posts.content:
Between 8 and 12, children can follow a multi-step build and still want it to feel like a toy. That is the window where a coding robot or a junior lab earns its shelf space.

What we put in the cart

Start with one open-ended kit, not five boxed experiments. The Coding Robot Starter Kit teaches sequence without a screen. The Junior Science Lab is better if they already like "why does this fizz?".

Leave the instructions nearby for the first session, then let them repeat it wrong. The repeat is the lesson.
blog_posts.author: Kidlo Team

blog_posts.title: How to Choose Safe Toys for Toddlers: A Parent's Complete Guide
blog_posts.excerpt: Everything you need to know about toy safety certifications, age labels, and what to look out for.
blog_posts.content:
Read the age floor before the photos. For toddlers, reject toys with button batteries, long cords, and parts that fit through a toilet-paper tube.

A quick check

  • Edges are smooth and paint does not smell sharp.
  • Soft toys have embroidered eyes, not plastic ones that pull off.
  • The box names a real brand you can search.

Kidlo marks an age range on every product page. If a listing and a box disagree, trust the stricter age and message us — we will correct the page.
blog_posts.author: Dr. Ali Hussain
